name: Evidence Grounding
rule: Every factual reasoning item must reference one or more evidence records.

name: No Unsupported Claims
rule: Missing evidence must not be converted into a scientific claim.

name: Known-Inferred Separation
rule: Observed evidence and model inference must remain separate.

name: Uncertainty Preservation
rule: Uncertainty must be retained in the reasoning state.

name: Knowledge Gap Preservation
rule: Missing evidence must be explicitly recorded.

name: Contradiction Preservation
rule: Conflicting evidence must not be silently removed.

name: Human Review Gate
rule: High-consequence scientific decisions require human review.

name: No Automatic Clinical Recommendation
rule: The reasoning layer cannot automatically issue clinical recommendations.
